policy.purpose: Create a small number of useful, query-aware entry points from Brali's existing knowledge instead of generating thin pages for keyword variants.
policy.search_metrics: Do not publish search volume, ranking, traffic, or trend claims unless they come from first-party analytics or a named external dataset.
policy.content_rule: Questions route readers to canonical Brali hubs, areas, research, and the Query Playground. They are navigation and editorial framing, not claims of measured demand.

groups.title: Focus & execution
groups.summary: Start work, reduce switching, and make priorities visible.
questions: How do I stop switching between tasks all day?
How do I start an important task when I keep procrastinating?
How do I plan a workday when everything feels urgent?
What is a simple way to protect a block of focused work?

groups.title: Habits & consistency
groups.summary: Make useful actions easier to repeat without relying on motivation alone.
questions: How do I make a habit easier to repeat?
What should I do when a habit keeps breaking on busy days?
How long does it really take to build a habit?
How can I reduce friction around a new routine?

groups.title: Learning & memory
groups.summary: Use retrieval, practice, feedback, and application instead of passive exposure alone.
questions: How do I remember more of what I study?
How do I learn through practice instead of rereading?
How can I run a one-week learning sprint?
What is the difference between remembering something and being able to use it?

groups.title: Sleep & energy
groups.summary: Build more reliable recovery routines while keeping evidence boundaries visible.
questions: How can I make my sleep routine more regular?
What small changes can make evening routines easier to repeat?
How should I think about sleep regularity without treating correlations as prescriptions?

groups.title: Stress & regulation
groups.summary: Find bounded, low-risk practices without turning a knowledge library into clinical care.
questions: What can I try when I feel stressed and need a simple next step?
How do I interrupt rumination without pretending one technique works for everyone?
What low-risk practices can help me settle before returning to a task?

groups.title: Movement & sedentary time
groups.summary: Break up long sitting periods and build sustainable movement routines.
questions: How can I move more when I sit at a desk most of the day?
Do movement breaks need a perfect interval to be useful?
What is a small way to restart an exercise routine?

groups.title: Communication & relationships
groups.summary: Navigate listening, clarity, conflict repair, and relationship skills.
questions: How can I listen better without immediately preparing my reply?
How do I make a difficult conversation clearer and less reactive?
What can I do after a conversation goes badly?

groups.title: Decisions, work & strategy
groups.summary: Use practical structures for prioritization, decisions, problem solving, and work.
questions: How do I make a decision when several options look reasonable?
How can I test an assumption before committing too much time?
How do I turn a vague work problem into a smaller next action?
